# LibreSCRS public ABI snapshot
# Generated by ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh
# Format: one demangled T-binding symbol per line, sorted; one
# section per public archive / SO, header line '== <basename> =='.
# Re-generate with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --update <build_dir>
# Diff a fresh build against this baseline with: ci/scripts/abi-snapshot.sh --check
#
# Scans whichever LibreSCRS_* surface is present in <build_dir>:
#   * SHARED build → libLibreSCRS_*.so.<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH> dynamic
#     T-binding symbols (the distro-installable ABI surface).
#   * STATIC build → libLibreSCRS_*.a archive T-binding symbols (the
#     monolithic SDK ABI surface; useful only when
#     LIBREMIDDLEWARE_BUILD_PLUGINS=OFF — see the FATAL_ERROR guard
#     in the root CMakeLists.txt).
# Both paths funnel through the same 'nm | c++filt | awk T | sort -u'
# pipeline so a single baseline applies to whichever mode CI runs.
